content.value: The star connected rotor of an induction motor has a standstill impedance of 1 (0.4 + j 4) ohm per phase and the rheostat impedance per phase is(6 + j 2) ohm.
The motor has an induced e.m.f of 80 V between slip-rings at standstill when connected to its normal supply voltage. Find –
(i) rotor current at standstill with the rheostat is in the circuit,
(ii)when the slip-rings are short-circuited and motor is running with a slip of 3%.

_source_title: B. Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
